result.summary: The app interface is mostly functional, exhibiting only minor layout and styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations serve as placeholders instead of real food photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement actual merchant imagery to improve user trust and appetite appeal.

issues.description: Text truncation occurs for longer merchant names in the horizontal scroll section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text container constraints or utilize marquee effects for long titles.

issues.description: Small white text on the light green promotional banner lacks high contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the background gradient or increase font weight for better readability.
